name: big_context
sql: SELECT count() AS sessions, max(PeakContextTokens) AS peak, sum(CostUsd) AS cost FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 7) AND PeakContextTokens > 600000

name: retries
sql: SELECT count() AS retries, sum(RetryDurationMs) / 60000 AS minutes_lost FROM agent_session_events WHERE EventKind = 'api_error' AND TimeUnixMs >= subtractDays(now(), 7)

name: oversized_tools
sql: SELECT count() AS results, uniqExact(ToolName) AS tools, sum(ToolResultBytes) / 4 * 0.000003 AS cost FROM agent_session_events WHERE EventKind = 'tool_result' AND ToolResultBytes > 200000 AND TimeUnixMs >= subtractDays(now(), 7)

name: rebuilds
sql: SELECT sum(CacheRebuildCount) AS rebuilds, max(LargestCacheRebuildTokens) AS largest FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 7)
